exclusion_detail: Lead 18x (4-butylphenoxy, pyridazin-4-yl amide) is made in 5 reactions: ethyl chloroacetate + isopropylamine (14a), chloroacetylation (15a), phenol ether formation with 4-butylphenol (16d), ester hydrolysis (17d), mixed-anhydride amide coupling with pyridazin-4-amine (18x).

lead.label: 18x
lead.why: Abstract: 'compound 18x proved to be the most potent compound (chymotrypsin-like: IC50 = 49 nM)'.

notes: All series members (18a-18ae, 12a-12c) need at least 5 reactions.
